title: Monotonicity of $\varepsilon$-farness in the degree bound
statement: Fix a Boolean function $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$, a real number $\varepsilon$ with $0 \le \varepsilon \le 1$, and natural numbers $d' \le d$. If $f$ is $\varepsilon$-far from degree $\le d$ — that is, $\dist(f, g) \ge \varepsilon$ for every Boolean function $g$ of degree $\le d$ — then $f$ is also $\varepsilon$-far from degree $\le d'$.
replaced:
If $d' \le d$ and $f$ is $\varepsilon$-far from degree $\le d$, then $f$ is also
$\varepsilon$-far from degree $\le d'$.
